title: Failover-test: Consul leader
description: Drives a Consul Raft leader-loss scenario against the live orchestration tier. SSHs into the current leader, stops `consul.service`, measures the time until a new leader emerges, then auto-recovers.

observe.what: scenario tag · original leader · new leader · RTO seconds · recovery state · timeline (pre-flight → failure-injected → new-leader-observed → recovery-attempted → cluster-healthy-again)
Servers panel briefly shows the killed node as `failed`, then `alive` again after recovery

whatProves: Consul's Raft re-elects a new leader within the lab's RTO budget after a hard service stop on the current leader (observed ~1.55s in 0.3.0). The CLI emits a structured timeline that lets an operator compare iterations.
